title: PaNET Update Process Defined
description: Following long discussions, we have successfully defined a standardized process for modifying the ontology, covering the knowledge base as well as technical questions.

title: PaN Training cross references
description: The PaN Training platform provides useful training material around Photons and Neutrons, also including the experimental techniques. We now provide links towards the material for each technique.

title: TS4NFDI Incubator Kick-Off Meeting
description: During the Kick-Off Meeting, we discussed the current status of PaNET and outlined the most important goals of the incubator. See the dashboard for more information.

title: TS4NFDI Incubator Approved
description: Our application to the TS4NFDI Incubator has been accepted! We will now receive expert support for all our questions around mappings.

title: Ontology Linter initiated
description: At a conference, we learned about LintedData, a linting tool for onotologies. We initiated the linter for PaNET. We are now working on activating all checks.

title: 1st Mapping to other vocabulary
description: Mappings connect terms and concepts listed in different semantic artifacts (e.g. vocabularies, ontologies). We created our first mapping: to Way For Light.

title: Release v1.3.0
description: We just released our new PaNET version. Highlights are the introduction of specifiers, 2 new terms, tidied-up relationships, and updated metadata.

title: Journal Publication Accepted
description: Our article 'Towards a new vision of PaNET: enhancing reasoning capabilities for better photon and neutron data discovery' has been accepted. Read the full article in Journal of Synchrotron Radiation.
